basic_details.scholarship_name: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) Chinese Government Scholarship (High-Level Postgraduate Program Type B)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC) & Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Sun Yat-sen University Campuses (Guangzhou, Zhuhai, and Shenzhen Campuses, Guangdong Province, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Computer Science and Engineering (Guangzhou/Shenzhen), School of Artificial Intelligence, School of Electronics and Communication Engineering, School of Biomedical Engineering, School of Marine Sciences, and School of Mathematics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 180 fully funded CSC Type B postgraduate scholarships allocated annually across colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Very generous bilateral allocation under China-Pakistan higher education partnerships; Pakistani scholars represent a leading international contingent at SYSU (~25 to 40 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 to 3 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: CNY 3,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 117,000 / month); CNY 3,500 / month for PhD (~PKR 136,500 / month) plus free university dormitory housing and comprehensive medical insurance

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master's applicants must be under 35 years of age; PhD applicants must be under 40 years of age per CSC statutory regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum 80% marks (or CGPA 3.20+ / 4.00) for Master's; recognized 18-year Master's degree with minimum 80% marks (or CGPA 3.20+ / 4.00) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 80% aggregate (or CGPA 3.2 / 4.0); competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.5 / 4.0.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, communications, or related STEM discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students graduating before July of application year.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in IEEE, ACM, or SCI/Scopus journals strongly advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 90, Duolingo 120+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted for English-taught graduate programs.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: HSK Level 4 or 5 required only for Chinese-taught degree majors.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply through both the CSC portal (Agency No. 10558) and the SYSU International Student Application System.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another concurrent Chinese government, provincial, or university award.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the complete official duration of the graduate degree program at SYSU.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~CNY 30,000 to 45,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,170,000 to 1,755,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: SYSU international application fee of CNY 400 (approx. USD 58 / ~PKR 16,000) paid online via university portal.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus international student dormitory accommodation (single room for PhD, twin room for Master's) on Guangzhou or Shenzhen campuses.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend disbursed directly to student bank accounts: CNY 3,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 117,000 / month); CNY 3,500 / month for PhD (~PKR 136,500 / month).

airfare.details: International relocation flights to Guangzhou/Shenzhen are self-funded by the student.
airfare.amount: Not covered in CSC Type B

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 Student Visa application fee (~PKR 15,000 to 22,000) paid directly to Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance for Foreign Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year value) 100% covered by CSC.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus cafeterias across all SYSU campuses; meals typically cost CNY 15 to 25 per day, easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full borrowing privileges across SYSU Libraries, electronic scientific databases, and access to Tianhe-2 Supercomputer at the National Supercomputer Center in Guangzhou.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: SYSU Graduate School and faculty research projects provide conference travel subsidies up to CNY 3,000 to 6,000 for approved papers.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CNY 6,000 research & conference funds

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university inter-campus shuttle bus network connecting Guangzhou North, South, and East campuses, plus discounted student metro passes.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite Chinese Double First Class / C9 partner university (Sun Yat-sen University).
participating_institutions: Sun Yat-sen University (Guangzhou South/East Campuses, Shenzhen Campus, Guangdong, China)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #260, Top 10 in Mainland China; home to National Supercomputer Center in Guangzhou (Tianhe-2) and premier research labs in AI, microelectronics, and marine science.
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computer Science and Technology
MSc / PhD in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data
MSc / PhD in Information and Communication Engineering
MSc / PhD in Marine Sciences and Ocean Engineering
MSc / PhD in Materials Physics and Chemistry
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 to 3 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 80%+ marks, verified transcripts, IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 90+ or MOI certificate, pre-acceptance letter from SYSU professor (strongly recommended), two professor recommendation letters, CV, study plan, and Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: School of Computer Science and Engineering is highly selective; securing an official Pre-Acceptance Letter / Form from an SYSU doctoral supervisor dramatically elevates scholarship success.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reach out to SYSU professors in Guangzhou and Shenzhen campuses with tailored research proposals connecting to high-performance computing, smart healthcare, or AI vision.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: SYSU International Student System & CSC Online Application System (Agency No. 10558)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit application on the CSC portal choosing Program Category B (Agency No. 10558 for SYSU), then submit on the SYSU International Student Application System, upload all supporting documents, and pay CNY 400 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact potential SYSU faculty supervisors and request a Foreigner Acceptance Letter.
Step 2: Obtain valid English proficiency test or MOI certificate, Foreigner Physical Examination report, and police character certificate.
Step 3: Register on CSC portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn), choose Type B, enter SYSU Agency No. 10558, and submit application.
Step 4: Register on SYSU portal (iso.sysu.edu.cn), complete online application, upload all documents including CSC form, and pay CNY 400 fee.
Step 5: SYSU academic departments review dossiers and conduct virtual interviews for shortlisted candidates.
Step 6: University nominates selected candidates to the China Scholarship Council for final approval.
Step 7: CSC issues official Admission Notice and JW201 Visa Form in July.
Step 8: Apply for Chinese X1 Visa at Chinese Visa Center and travel to Guangzhou/Shenzhen for September registration.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Recommendation Track (CSC Type B): Admission and scholarship are processed concurrently by SYSU and confirmed by CSC.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate as signed and stamped official PDF letters from full professors or associate professors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study and research plan (minimum 1,000 words for Master's, 1,500 words for PhD) describing research background, proposed thesis topic, and study objectives in China.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Comprehensive research proposal outlining research domain, methodologies, experimental designs, and alignment with SYSU laboratory facilities.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, research projects, technical skills, and academic awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Departmental faculty panel interview via Tencent Meeting / VooV / Zoom evaluating subject knowledge and research aptitude.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+, TOEFL 90+, Duolingo 120+, or English MOI certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized copies of degrees and transcripts; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Chinese translation of all non-English/non-Chinese documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual online submission via CSC portal and SYSU international student portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Notarized Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Bachelor's / Master's degree with minimum 80% aggregate marks from an accredited university.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC, MoFA Pakistan, and notarized.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Formal research proposal (minimum 1,000 words Master's / 1,500 words PhD) detailing proposed research project.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Two Letters of Recommendation from Professors
required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential letters from full or associate professors with contact details and signatures.
Standard Chinese medical examination form completed, signed, and stamped by an authorized hospital with lab test results.
Official police character clearance certificate issued within the last 6 months.
IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 90+, Duolingo 120+, or official English Medium of Instruction certificate.
Clear color copy of passport bio-data page valid beyond March 2026.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: February 15 (CSC Type B deadline) / March 31 (University direct scholarship deadline)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for Fall entry; CSC Type B applications strictly due in mid-February.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior academic GPA, university standing, course rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Prior publications, research proposal quality, professor pre-acceptance)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SYSU School Admissions Committee, International Student Office, and China Scholarship Council Evaluation Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive multi-stage academic evaluation based on prior GPA, research publications, supervisor endorsement, and interview performance.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 international postgraduate applicants across SYSU
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 180 fully funded CSC Type B awards annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.0% to 9.0% for applicants with professor pre-acceptance and published papers
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.40 / 4.00, accompanied by 1+ peer-reviewed conference or journal publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates holding strong bachelor's or master's degrees in STEM, with documented research capability, pre-acceptance from an SYSU professor, and clean records.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from Pakistani engineering and science institutions (NUST, FAST, COMSATS, UET Lahore, Quaid-i-Azam, GIKI, PIEAS).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Bangladesh, Vietnam.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portals at iso.sysu.edu.cn and studyinchina.csc.edu.cn.
Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell guaranteed CSC scholarship seats; CSC strictly prohibits intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of CNY 400 is paid directly through the secure SYSU online portal; the CSC portal itself is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications prepared by commercial agents with templated research proposals are systematically rejected by SYSU.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Chinese X1 Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 18,000.
Medical checkup & police certificate attestations: ~PKR 25,000 to 35,000.
Initial relocation flight to Guangzhou/Shenzhen: ~PKR 180,000 to 250,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend disbursement: ~CNY 1,500 (~PKR 58,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need HSK Chinese fluency. Reality: All STEM graduate programs are taught and examined 100% in English.
Myth: Pre-acceptance letters are required. Reality: Not legally mandatory, but having a professor's pre-acceptance letter increases admission likelihood to over 70%.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim CSC covers international airfare; CSC Type B university programs do NOT cover international airfare.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass the Annual CSC Comprehensive Review evaluating academic credits, research progress, and campus conduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Guangzhou or Shenzhen; unexcused absences result in stipend deduction.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual CSC review conducted every May by the host school and International Student Office.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Commercial off-campus employment is restricted by Chinese student visa regulations; part-time on-campus work-study permitted with university approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are free to pursue post-doctoral fellowships, corporate employment in China, or return home.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero financial bond or service commitment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled and student repatriated if dismissed for academic failure, disciplinary infractions, or criminal offenses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other Chinese universities under CSC rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major is strictly prohibited after scholarship registration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are generally not granted; students must complete degrees within the official approved period.
